department: International Doctoral Program Environment Water (ENWAT), Faculty 2

deadline.value: The programme lists no application deadline for its project positions.

gre_subject.value: The ENWAT application page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A signed agreement on doctoral studies with the supervisor is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: Signed agreement on doctoral studies with: Work plan and timetable and information on your individual qualification program

funding.value: Applicants must already have verified full funding; applications without it are not considered.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree or equivalent is required.
entry_route.quote: MSc (or an equivalent degree) relevant for the respective project

toefl_min.value: The programme accepts 80 or more on the internet-based TOEFL.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL test results indicating a minimum score of 80 points (internet-based testing)

ielts_min.value: The programme asks for an IELTS Academic band score of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS test results indicating an Academic Bandscore: 6.5

english_waiver.value: A bachelor's or master's course taught in English is accepted as proof of English, so an English-medium degree waives the test.
english_waiver.quote: Medium of Instruction (MoI): Proof that the candidate has successfully completed a university course (e.g. B.Sc. or M.Sc.) taught in English.

notes: Project-based programme in Faculty 2; applicants must bring verified full funding. Civil engineering applicants can also apply, but civil is saved separately under the faculty rules.
